disney-junior-cinema-club-2026.title: Disney Junior Cinema Club 2026
disney-junior-cinema-club-2026.overview: Packed with fun for preschoolers and their grown-ups, this interactive big-screen experience brings together some favourite Disney Junior stories from Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+, Minnie's Bow-Toons: Pet Hotel, Marvel's Iron Man and His Awesome Friends, Sofia the First: Royal Magic and Toy Story Toons, in a fun-filled extravaganza! Expect sing-alongs, dance moments, exciting games and magical surprises, where audience participation is a must.

amazing-grace.title: Amazing Grace
amazing-grace.overview: The true story of William Wilberforce and his courageous quest to end the British slave trade. Along the way, Wilberforce meets intense opposition, but his minister urges him to see the cause through.
amazing-grace.cast: Ioan Gruffudd, Romola Garai, Ciarán Hinds, Rufus Sewell, Youssou N'Dour, Benedict Cumberbatch

monster-mia.title: Monster Mia
monster-mia.overview: 12-year-old Mia and her scruffy pet rat Quentin are sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy after one too many problems at school. The new school gives her the creeps, and Mia needs to figure a way out before the students realize she isn't a monster like them! But the vice principal Van Vlad hosts a particular dislike for humans, and Mia is scared he has seen through her act...
monster-mia.cast: Lilian Jane Gartner, Dunja Bernatzky, Verena Altenberger, Silvia Schneider, Susi Stach, Michael Ostrowski

godzilla-minus-zero.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
godzilla-minus-zero.overview: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.
godzilla-minus-zero.cast: Ryunosuke Kamiki, Minami Hamabe, Yuki Yamada, Kuranosuke Sasaki, Jun Kunimura, Miou Tanaka

i-play-rocky.title: I Play Rocky
i-play-rocky.overview: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.
i-play-rocky.cast: Anthony Ippolito, AnnaSophia Robb, Stephan James, Matt Dillon, P.J. Byrne, Jay Duplass

the-rocky-horror-picture-show.title: The Rocky Horror Picture Show
the-rocky-horror-picture-show.overview: After getting a flat tire in the middle of nowhere, newly engaged couple Brad and Janet encounter the eerie mansion of the flamboyant, seductive Dr Frank-N-Furter and a variety of eccentric characters. Through elaborate dance and rock music, the mad scientist unveils his latest creation: a perfect, muscular man.
the-rocky-horror-picture-show.cast: Tim Curry, Susan Sarandon, Barry Bostwick, Richard O'Brien, Patricia Quinn, Nell Campbell

ebenezer.title: Ebenezer
ebenezer.overview: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.
ebenezer.cast: Johnny Depp, Rupert Grint, Daisy Ridley, Andrea Riseborough, Tramell Tillman, Ian McKellen

rififi-en-la-ciudad.title: Rififi
rififi-en-la-ciudad.overview: Out of prison after a five-year stretch, jewel thief Tony turns down a quick job his friend Jo offers him, until he discovers that his old girlfriend Mado has become the lover of local gangster Pierre Grutter during Tony's absence. Expanding a minor smash-and-grab into a full-scale jewel heist, Tony and his crew appear to get away clean, but their actions after the job is completed threaten the lives of everyone involved.
rififi-en-la-ciudad.cast: Jean Servais, Carl Möhner, Robert Manuel, Janine Darcey, Pierre Grasset, Robert Hossein

how-to-rob-a-bank.title: How to Rob a Bank
how-to-rob-a-bank.overview: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.
how-to-rob-a-bank.cast: Nicholas Hoult, Zoë Kravitz, Anna Sawai, Rhenzy Feliz, Pete Davidson, John C. Reilly

focker-in-law.title: Focker-in-Law
focker-in-law.overview: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.
focker-in-law.cast: Ben Stiller, Robert De Niro, Ariana Grande, Skyler Gisondo, Owen Wilson, Blythe Danner

festive-fun-with-peppa-cinema-experience.title: Festive Fun with Peppa
festive-fun-with-peppa-cinema-experience.overview: Join Peppa Pig and her family as they celebrate baby Evie’s first Christmas. This festive cinema experience brings together seven classic festive-themed Peppa Pig episodes, new interstitial content, and four brand-new songs with music videos. From snowy adventures and festive plays to decorating the Christmas tree, Peppa and her family share treasured Christmas memories in this special big-screen experience.
festive-fun-with-peppa-cinema-experience.cast: Morwenna Banks, Richard Ridings, Amelie Bea Smith

the-hunger-games-sunrise-on-the-reaping.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
the-hunger-games-sunrise-on-the-reaping.overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
the-hunger-games-sunrise-on-the-reaping.cast: Joseph Zada, Ralph Fiennes, Jesse Plemons, Whitney Peak, Elle Fanning, Mckenna Grace

room-on-the-broom-the-highway-rat.title: Room on the Broom
room-on-the-broom-the-highway-rat.overview: Animated film based on the wonderful children's picture book written by Julia Donaldson and illustrated by Axel Scheffler.  The story of a kind witch who invites a surprising collection of animals to join her on her broom, much to the frustration of her cat. The gang ultimately saves the witch from a fearsome dragon, and in gratitude she rewards them with a magnificent new broom which has room for everyone.  A magical tale about friendship and family from Magic Light Pictures, the producers of the hugely successful The Gruffalo and The Gruffalo's Child.
room-on-the-broom-the-highway-rat.cast: Gillian Anderson, Timothy Spall, Sally Hawkins, Rob Brydon, Martin Clunes, Simon Pegg

hexed.title: Hexed
hexed.overview: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.
hexed.cast: Hailee Steinfeld, Rashida Jones, Jodie Foster, Walton Goggins, Tracey Ullman, Stephen Fry

prima-facie.title: Prima Facie
prima-facie.overview: Tessa is a brilliant British defence barrister dominating London’s ruthless courtrooms. Fierce, witty, and self-made, she defends men accused of sexual assault — until she is assaulted herself by a colleague from a powerful legal dynasty.  Suddenly, the system she trusted turns against her. As she faces the same tactics she once used in court, Tessa’s faith in justice unravels. Once in control, now exposed and disbelieved, she must fight to reclaim her voice and sense of self.
prima-facie.cast: Cynthia Erivo, Daniel Ings, Elizabeth Dulau, Noma Dumezweni, Toheeb Jimoh, Harry Treadaway

wild-horse-nine.title: Wild Horse Nine
wild-horse-nine.overview: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.
wild-horse-nine.cast: John Malkovich, Sam Rockwell, Steve Buscemi, Mariana di Girolamo, Ailín Salas, Tom Waits

violent-night-2.title: Violent Night 2
violent-night-2.overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.
violent-night-2.cast: David Harbour, Kristen Bell, Daniela Melchior, Jared Harris, Joe Pantoliano, Maxwell Jacob Friedman

avengers-doomsday.title: Avengers: Doomsday
avengers-doomsday.overview: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.
avengers-doomsday.cast: Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, Chris Hemsworth, Pedro Pascal, Paul Rudd, Anthony Mackie

jumanji-open-world.title: Jumanji: Open World
jumanji-open-world.overview: Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us - as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.
jumanji-open-world.cast: Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Jack Black, Karen Gillan, Awkwafina, Alex Wolff

werwulf.title: Werwulf
werwulf.overview: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.
werwulf.cast: Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Lily-Rose Depp, Willem Dafoe, Bodhi Rae Breathnach, Ralph Ineson, Vidal Arzoni

ink.title: Ink
ink.overview: A group of misfits and visionaries had an idea for a new kind of news - one that would give the people what they want, and would change the face of the world we live in today.
ink.cast: Jack O'Connell, Guy Pearce, Claire Foy, Blake Harrison, Patrick Kennedy, Angus Imrie

ice-age-boiling-point.title: Ice Age: Boiling Point
ice-age-boiling-point.overview: A dinosaur-and-lava-filled madcap adventure takes Manny, Sid, Diego, Ellie, Buck, acorn-obsessed Scrat – this time joined by Baby Scrat and the enormous Jurassic Scrat – and the rest of the herd to visit never before-seen corners of the treacherous Lost World.
ice-age-boiling-point.cast: Ray Romano, John Leguizamo, Denis Leary, Simon Pegg, Queen Latifah, Seann William Scott

remain.title: Remain
remain.overview: When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.
remain.cast: Jake Gyllenhaal, Phoebe Dynevor, Ashley Walters, Julie Hagerty, Jay O. Sanders, Tracy Ifeachor

narnia-the-magician-s-nephew.title: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew
narnia-the-magician-s-nephew.overview: Two children discover a wood full of pools leading to other worlds. One takes them to a dead city beneath a dying sun, where they wake a queen who exterminated its population and accidentally bring her back to London.
narnia-the-magician-s-nephew.cast: David McKenna, Beatrice Campbell, Emma Mackey, Carey Mulligan, Ciarán Hinds, Daniel Craig

cocomelon-the-movie.title: CoComelon: The Movie
cocomelon-the-movie.overview: JJ embarks on the biggest adventure of his life: Kindergarten. But when, on his first day at school, JJ discovers that his beloved stuffed bear Boba has gone missing, JJ and his friends Cody, CeCe and Nina will begin a quest that will transport them into a magical land ruled by Princess Harmony, who has created a world with one rule: No singing.
cocomelon-the-movie.cast: Connor Esterson, Camden Brooks, Aerina DeBoer, Olivia London Leyva, SZA, Ike Barinholtz

the-angry-birds-movie-3.title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
the-angry-birds-movie-3.overview: Red faces his greatest challenge yet - surviving fatherhood - while saving the world.
the-angry-birds-movie-3.cast: Jason Sudeikis, Josh Gad, Danny McBride, Rachel Bloom, Emma Myers, Walker Scobell

dune-part-three.title: Dune: Part Three
dune-part-three.overview: Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium, Paul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor, and must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.
dune-part-three.cast: Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Isaach de Bankolé

the-exorcist-martyrs.title: The Exorcist: Martyrs
the-exorcist-martyrs.overview: Thirteen years ago, New York City detective Julie Miller ended the terror reign of satanic serial killer Father Sunday. The case made her a hero, and she has thrown herself into her work ever since. Now a new killer scrawls her name in an altar boy's blood on the walls of a church crypt, dragging her back into the darkness she believed she had buried with him.
the-exorcist-martyrs.cast: Scarlett Johansson, Sasha Calle, Chiwetel Ejiofor, John Leguizamo, Laurence Fishburne, Diane Lane

shrek-5.title: Shrek 5
shrek-5.overview: Shrek and Donkey team up for another whirlwind, big-city adventure, this time in the magical city of Further Further Away.
shrek-5.cast: Mike Myers, Eddie Murphy, Cameron Diaz, Marcello Hernández, Skyler Gisondo, Zendaya

not-alone.title: Not Alone
not-alone.overview: While preparing for a revolutionary space launch, an introverted rocket mechanic and a brilliant astro-botanist spark an unexpected romance—only for three runaway aliens to crash-land in his home, looking for a ride back to the stars.
not-alone.director: Eric Guillon, Claire Dodgson, Jonathan del Val
not-alone.cast: Timothée Chalamet, Selena Gomez, Rob Brydon, Diane Morgan, Jamie Demetriou, Brett Goldstein

street-fighter.title: Street Fighter
street-fighter.overview: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!
street-fighter.cast: Andrew Koji, Noah Centineo, Callina Liang, David Dastmalchian, Andrew Schulz, Joe Anoa'i

clayface.title: Clayface
clayface.overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.
clayface.cast: Tom Rhys Harries, Naomi Ackie, Eddie Marsan, Max Minghella, David Dencik, Francesca Corney

hocus-pocus.title: Hocus Pocus
hocus-pocus.overview: After 300 years of slumber, three sister witches are accidentally resurrected in Salem on Halloween night, and it is up to three kids and their newfound feline friend to put an end to the witches' reign of terror once and for all.
hocus-pocus.cast: Omri Katz, Thora Birch, Vinessa Shaw, Bette Midler, Sarah Jessica Parker, Kathy Najimy

tad-and-the-magic-lamp.title: Tad and The Magic Lamp
tad-and-the-magic-lamp.overview: Tadeo, his girlfriend Sara, and his friends Momia, Jeff, and Belzoni embark on an adventure after Tadeo accidentally unleashes an ancient spell.
tad-and-the-magic-lamp.cast: Óscar Barberán, Michelle Jenner, Luis Posada, Joseph Balderrama, Trevor White

wildwood.title: Wildwood
wildwood.overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.
wildwood.cast: Carey Mulligan, Peyton Elizabeth Lee, Jacob Tremblay, Mahershala Ali, Angela Bassett, Awkwafina

forgotten-island.title: Forgotten Island
forgotten-island.overview: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.
forgotten-island.cast: H.E.R., Liza Soberano, Dave Franco, Jenny Slate, Manny Jacinto, Lea Salonga

ghosts-the-possession-of-button-house.title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
ghosts-the-possession-of-button-house.overview: It's a matter of life and death for Alison, Mike, Mia and the Ghosts.
ghosts-the-possession-of-button-house.cast: Simon Farnaby, Jim Howick, Ben Willbond, Laurence Rickard, Martha Howe-Douglas, Lolly Adefope

hadestown-the-musical.title: Hadestown: The Musical
hadestown-the-musical.overview: The tragic love of Orpheus and Eurydice is intertwined with the complex relationship of Hades and Persephone. Eurydice, struggling with poverty, is lured to the industrial underworld of Hadestown by Hades, while Orpheus, a struggling musician, ventures down below to bring her back. (Filmed live at the Lyric Theatre, London, featuring the core five original Broadway cast members.)
hadestown-the-musical.cast: Reeve Carney, Eva Noblezada, André De Shields, Patrick Page, Amber Gray, Bella Brown

andrew-lloyd-webber-s-starlight-express-.title: Starlight Express
andrew-lloyd-webber-s-starlight-express-.overview: Andrew Lloyd Webber's, 'Starlight Express' races back onto the stage in a spectacular new production, where trains come to life, dreams are on the line, and only one can become champion.
andrew-lloyd-webber-s-starlight-express-.cast: Jeevan Braich, Kayna Montecillo, Jade Marvin, Olivia Ringrose, Asher Forth, Sophie Naglik

minions-monsters.title: Minions & Monsters
minions-monsters.overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.
minions-monsters.cast: Pierre Coffin, Trey Parker, Christoph Waltz, Allison Janney, Jesse Eisenberg, Jeff Bridges

giant-the-play.title: Giant
giant-the-play.overview: Set in the summer of 1983, just before the release of The Witches, Giant imagines a tense meeting between Roald Dahl and his American and British publishers as they scramble to contain the fallout from his public denunciation of Israel and defence of the Palestinians in a review of a book on the 1982 Lebanon war. Filmed live onstage at the Harold Pinter Theatre in London's West End in 2025.
giant-the-play.cast: John Lithgow, Elliot Levey, Aya Cash, Rachael Stirling, Tessa Bonham Jones, Richard Hope

ali-g-who-iz-i.title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
ali-g-who-iz-i.overview: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.
ali-g-who-iz-i.cast: Sacha Baron Cohen, Morgana Robinson, A$AP Rocky, Rihanna, C. Stewart Rodeheaver, Allan Lichtman

heart-of-the-beast.title: Heart of the Beast
heart-of-the-beast.overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.
heart-of-the-beast.cast: Brad Pitt, J.K. Simmons, Anna Lambe, Justin Melnick, Shaun DeZern

hay-fever.title: Hay Fever
hay-fever.overview: A confrontational and friendly judge gets in trouble when his wife is trying to arouse his jealousy of her long-term relationship with their mutual friend Chief Klausen. Superintendent and is still convinced that he strives against his life. At the same time the judge's chess friend Lise not stand that he was not hitting on her. All intricacies rubs judge with a serious time hay fever
hay-fever.cast: Frits Helmuth, Lisbet Dahl, Kirsten Lehfeldt, Axel Strøbye, Thomas Mørk, Peter Schrøder

the-motive-and-the-cue.title: National Theatre Live: The Motive and the Cue
the-motive-and-the-cue.overview: Returning to cinemas in 2027. In 1964, Richard Burton, newly married to Elizabeth Taylor, is to play the title role in an experimental new Broadway production of Hamlet under Sir John Gielgud’s exacting direction. But as rehearsals progress, two ages of theatre collide and the collaboration between actor and director soon threatens to unravel.
the-motive-and-the-cue.cast: Johnny Flynn, Mark Gatiss, Tuppence Middleton, Aysha Kala, Luke Norris, Allan Corduner

shaun-the-sheep-the-beast-of-mossy-botto.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
shaun-the-sheep-the-beast-of-mossy-botto.overview: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go awry when a wild beast appears in the woods.
shaun-the-sheep-the-beast-of-mossy-botto.cast: Justin Fletcher, John Sparkes, Nina Sosanya, Kate Harbour, Rich Webber, Emma Tate

paw-patrol-the-dino-movie.title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
paw-patrol-the-dino-movie.overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.
paw-patrol-the-dino-movie.cast: Carter Young, Mckenna Grace, Terry Crews, Meredith MacNeill, Ron Pardo, Jennifer Hudson

andre-rieu-s-2026-christmas-concert-let-.title: Andre Rieu's 2026 Christmas Concert Let It Snow
andre-rieu-s-2026-christmas-concert-let-.overview: Andre Rieu's annual concert celebrating the magic of Christmas.

the-royal-ballet-manon.title: The Royal Ballet: Manon
the-royal-ballet-manon.overview: Torn between her desire of a life of splendour and riches and her devotion to her true love Des Grieux, the feckless and capricious Manon pays the ultimate price.

sense-and-sensibility.title: Sense and Sensibility
sense-and-sensibility.overview: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.
sense-and-sensibility.cast: Daisy Edgar-Jones, Esmé Creed-Miles, Bodhi Rae Breathnach, Caitríona Balfe, Fiona Shaw, George MacKay

pressure.title: Pressure
pressure.overview: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.
pressure.cast: Andrew Scott, Brendan Fraser, Kerry Condon, Chris Messina, Damian Lewis, Tamsin Topolski

casper.title: Casper
casper.overview: Casper is a kind young ghost who peacefully haunts a mansion in Maine. When specialist James Harvey arrives to communicate with Casper and his fellow spirits, he brings along his teenage daughter, Kat. Casper quickly falls in love with Kat, but their budding relationship is complicated not only by his transparent state, but also by his troublemaking apparition uncles and their mischievous antics.
casper.cast: Malachi Pearson, Christina Ricci, Bill Pullman, Cathy Moriarty, Eric Idle, Joe Alaskey

hotel-transylvania.title: Hotel Transylvania
hotel-transylvania.overview: Welcome to Hotel Transylvania, Dracula's lavish five-stake resort, where monsters and their families can live it up and no humans are allowed. One special weekend, Dracula has invited all his best friends to celebrate his beloved daughter Mavis's 118th birthday. For Dracula catering to all of these legendary monsters is no problem but the party really starts when one ordinary guy stumbles into the hotel and changes everything!
hotel-transylvania.cast: Selena Gomez, Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg, Kevin James, Fran Drescher, Steve Buscemi

the-lost-boys.title: The Lost Boys
the-lost-boys.overview: When an unsuspecting town newcomer is drawn to local blood fiends, the Frog brothers and other unlikely heroes gear up to rescue him.
the-lost-boys.cast: Jason Patric, Corey Haim, Dianne Wiest, Barnard Hughes, Edward Herrmann, Kiefer Sutherland

golden-boy.title: Golden Boy
golden-boy.overview: GOLDEN BOY is the story of James, a young man who gambles on the dangers of being seen versus the quiet life of desperation and invisibility. Saved from doomed nonexistence by CQ, a wealthy debonair businessman with more going on than meets the eye, and introduced to a world he is not ready to navigate. We follow him as he chases his dreams -- while losing himself, one piece at a time. GOLDEN BOY is a story with universal themes. Trust. Seduction. Betrayal. Redemption.
golden-boy.cast: Mark Elias, Lex Medlin, Logan Donovan, Paul Culos, Kimberly Westbrook, Armin Shimerman

the-royal-opera-carmen.title: Royal Ballet & Opera 2026/27: Carmen
the-royal-opera-carmen.overview: Under the oppressive heat of the Spanish sun, the fiercely independent Carmen attracts the attention of Don José. She warns him not to fall in love with her, but his obsession knows no bounds. Damiano Michieletto’s searing production returns, casting scorching light on the lust, violence and destructive desire of Bizet’s ever-popular opera. An all-star cast brings this white-hot drama to life, with Ginger Costa-Jackson in the fiery title role, alongside Russell Thomas as the jealous and despairing Don José. Following his 2023 Royal Opera debut, Sesto Quatrini returns to conduct Bizet’s electrifying and sensual score.

doctor-who-the-satan-pit.title: Doctor Who: The Satan Pit
doctor-who-the-satan-pit.overview: Join the Doctor and Rose as they travel to Sanctuary Base 6, a remote outpost perched on a planet orbiting a black hole. When an ancient force awakens beneath the surface, the crew find themselves trapped in a battle against an evil older than time itself.
doctor-who-the-satan-pit.cast: David Tennant, Billie Piper, Danny Webb, Will Thorp, Claire Rushbrook, Ronny Jhutti

whispers-in-the-woods.title: Whispers in the Woods
whispers-in-the-woods.overview: In the heart of the tranquil Vosges forests, where lynxes, bears and deer roam freely, Vincent Munier accompanies his father on his expeditions. He not only seeks to capture the visual wonders of this forest kingdom, but also aims to make its sounds audible. Every whisper of the forest is a reminder of the knowledge of nature that his father once imbued in him – knowledge that Vincent now passes on to his own son. Vincent Munier combines breathtaking footage of nature and its sounds to create a fairytale-like cinematic experience that slows time down.
whispers-in-the-woods.cast: Michel Munier, Simon Munier, Vincent Munier

the-royal-ballet-the-nutcracker.title: The Royal Ballet: The Nutcracker
the-royal-ballet-the-nutcracker.overview: Clara is given an enchanted Nutcracker doll on Christmas Eve. As midnight strikes, she creeps downstairs to find a magical adventure awaiting her and her Nutcracker.  The magician Drosselmeyer transforms the drawing room into a battle between mice and toy soldiers. During the battle, Clara saves the Nutcracker’s life – so breaking a magical spell that turned him from a boy to a toy – and the Mouse King is defeated. In celebration, Drosselmeyer sweeps Clara and the Nutcracker off to the Kingdom of Sweets, where they meet the Sugar Plum Fairy and take part in a wonderful display of dances. The next morning, Clara’s adventures seem to have been more than just a dream.
the-royal-ballet-the-nutcracker.cast: Anna Rose O'Sullivan, Marcelino Sambé, Thomas Whitehead, Sophie Allnatt, Leo Dixon

the-royal-opera-cos-fan-tutte.title: Royal Ballet & Opera 2026/27: Così fan tutte

the-royal-ballet-alice-s-adventures-in-w.title: Royal Ballet & Opera 2026/27: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
the-royal-ballet-alice-s-adventures-in-w.overview: At a garden party on a sunny afternoon, Alice is surprised to see her parents’ friend Lewis Carroll transform into a white rabbit. When she follows him down a rabbit hole, events become curiouser and curiouser…As Alice journeys through Wonderland, she encounters countless strange creatures. She’s swept off her feet by the charming Knave of Hearts, who’s on the run for stealing the tarts. Confusion piles upon confusion. Then Alice wakes with a start. Was it all a daydream?

ozzy-black-sabbath-back-to-the-beginning.title: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
ozzy-black-sabbath-back-to-the-beginning.overview: A powerful return to roots, this concert captures Black Sabbath in peak form - reuniting to deliver classic hits with raw energy and legendary precision.
ozzy-black-sabbath-back-to-the-beginning.cast: Ozzy Osbourne, Tony Iommi, Geezer Butler, Bill Ward, Jason Momoa, Zakk Wylde

whalefall.title: Whalefall
whalefall.overview: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.
whalefall.cast: Austin Abrams, Josh Brolin, Elisabeth Shue, John Ortiz, Jane Levy, Emily Rudd

other-mommy.title: Other Mommy
other-mommy.overview: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.
other-mommy.cast: Jessica Chastain, Jay Duplass, Arabella Olivia Clark, Karen Allen, Arian Moayed, Dichen Lachman

the-royal-ballet-swan-lake.title: The Royal Ballet: Swan Lake
the-royal-ballet-swan-lake.overview: Prince Siegfried chances upon a flock of swans while out hunting. When one of the swans turns into a beautiful woman, Odette, he is enraptured. But she is under a spell that holds her captive, allowing her to regain her human form only at night.

verity.title: Verity
verity.overview: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.
verity.cast: Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, Josh Hartnett, Brady Wagner, Ismael Cruz Cordova, Irina Dvorovenko

all-rivers-spill-their-stories-to-the-se.title: All Rivers Spill Their Stories to the Sea
all-rivers-spill-their-stories-to-the-se.overview: On England’s North East coast, where rivers, heavy industry and the sea have shaped lives for generations, fisherman Stan Rennie is watching the world he knows disappear. His family have worked these waters for generations. Then, almost overnight, thousands of dead crabs and lobsters wash ashore, and a community already living with uncertainty is pushed into crisis. Teesside filmmaker Jeanie Finlay brings warmth, wit and deep local feeling to this David-and-Goliath story of environmental damage, official evasions and working-class resilience. At its centre is Stan: funny, stubborn, vulnerable and increasingly determined to be heard.

the-royal-opera-tosca.title: Royal Ballet & Opera 2025/26: Tosca
the-royal-opera-tosca.overview: In war-torn Rome, Floria Tosca and Mario Cavaradossi live for each other and for their art. But when Cavaradossi helps an escaped prisoner, the lovers make a deadly enemy in the form of Baron Scarpia, Chief of Police. At the mercy of Scarpia’s twisted desires, Tosca is forced to make a horrific bargain: sleeping with the man she hates in order to save the man she loves. Can she find a way out?
the-royal-opera-tosca.cast: Anna Netrebko, Freddie De Tommaso, Gerald Finley, Carlo Bosi, Ossian Huskinson, Alessandro Corbelli

exhibition-on-screen-monet.title: Exhibition on Screen: Monet
exhibition-on-screen-monet.overview: To coincide with a major exhibition at Tate Britain, Exhibition on Screen brings a brand-new film dedicated to the father of Impressionism, Claude Monet. The documentary explores his passion, rebellion, and his revolutionary mastery of light and color.

the-royal-ballet-romeo-juliet.title: The Royal Ballet: Romeo and Juliet
the-royal-ballet-romeo-juliet.overview: An ancient family feud casts a long shadow over the town of Verona. In this hothouse of tension, brawls are quick to break out and both sides get caught in the crossfire.
the-royal-ballet-romeo-juliet.cast: Vadim Muntagirov, Fumi Kaneko, Francisco Serrano, Ryoichi Hirano, Giacomo Rovero, Lukas Bjørneboe Brændsrød

klara-and-the-sun.title: Klara and the Sun
klara-and-the-sun.overview: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.
klara-and-the-sun.cast: Jenna Ortega, Mia Tharia, Amy Adams, Natasha Lyonne, Aran Murphy, Rachel House

exhibition-on-screen-renoir-love.title: Exhibition on Screen: Monet
exhibition-on-screen-renoir-love.overview: To coincide with a major exhibition at Tate Britain, Exhibition on Screen brings a brand-new film dedicated to the father of Impressionism, Claude Monet. The documentary explores his passion, rebellion, and his revolutionary mastery of light and color.

kpop-party.title: KPop Demon Hunters
kpop-party.overview: When K-pop superstars Rumi, Mira and Zoey aren't selling out stadiums, they're using their secret powers to protect their fans from supernatural threats.
kpop-party.cast: Arden Cho, May Hong, Ji-young Yoo, Ahn Hyo-seop, Yunjin Kim, Ken Jeong

resident-evil.title: Resident Evil
resident-evil.overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.
resident-evil.cast: Austin Abrams, Paul Walter Hauser, Kali Reis, Zach Cherry, Johnno Wilson, Shaun W. Loeser

tease.title: Tease
tease.overview: A man in a movie production office partially strips for the camera.

jim-davidson-no-holds-barred.title: Jim Davidson: No Further Action - Back & Live
jim-davidson-no-holds-barred.overview: Comedy legend Jim Davidson returns with his brand new DVD Back & Live! filmed during his No Further Action UK tour. Jim takes a wry look at what life is like under investigation in the public eye as he tells the story of his year from hell following his arrest by Operation Yewtree detectives. He gives an honest and witty account of fighting to clear his name, subsequently having all allegations against him dropped and winning the heart of the nation all over again when he was crowned the winner of the most successful series of Big Brother by a landslide public vote. Hear the outrageous unseen stories of the Celebrity Big Brother house and what Jim really thought about his fellow housemates!

scummy-mummies-on-the-edge.title: Scummy Man
scummy-mummies-on-the-edge.overview: Nina is easy to find. She is on the industrial estate, near the gas tower, She is fifteen, addicted to drugs and on the game. George is one of her nastier punters. His arrival turns the temperature up on her already combusting life. He is the scummiest of scummy men, someone you really don't want to be involved with, at all. A magician and a taxi driver offer Nina a quick fix but doesn't everyone want something in return? She won't take it lying down. Scummy man is a gripping glimpse into the lost and misplaced lives on todays back streets. The film is brutally honest, intense and not afraid.
scummy-mummies-on-the-edge.cast: Stephen Graham, Lauren Socha, David McClelland, Andrew Turner, Anne Prendergast, Matthew Helders

the-americana-revue.title: What Happened At The Americana?
the-americana-revue.overview: A group of actors are invited to a cast dinner where they discover the dead body of their director. As the situation escalates they soon forget about the murder and become focused only on their own personal agendas and problems.
the-americana-revue.cast: Charlie Blanshard, Emily Stefan, Ryan Carley, Mollie Crone, Cameron Lloyd Morris

amazing-animals.title: Amazing Animals
amazing-animals.overview: Jason Kenzie, a local pet photojournalist discovers a myriad of exotic animals living in the backyards of the lower mainland of British Columbia Canada.

the-carpenters-story.title: Only Yesterday: The Carpenters Story
the-carpenters-story.overview: Documentary about brother and sister duo The Carpenters, one of the biggest-selling pop acts of the 1970s, but one with a destructive and complex secret that ended in tragedy.
the-carpenters-story.cast: Richard Carpenter, Karen Carpenter, Herb Alpert, Linda Perry

fred-dinenage-s-ronnie-reggie-me.title: Fred
fred-dinenage-s-ronnie-reggie-me.overview: After a cozy date, Noelia and Fred decide to move somewhere more private. Unfortunately for her, his intentions are not what they seem. Now, Noelia must escape through a dark forest to avoid becoming part of something far more sinister.

the-overtones-up-close-and-personal.title: The Odyssey
the-overtones-up-close-and-personal.overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.
the-overtones-up-close-and-personal.cast: Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson, Himesh Patel, Charlize Theron

locomotive-for-murder-the-improvised-who.title: The Railways: Engine of Progress
locomotive-for-murder-the-improvised-who.overview: When the first railroads were built some two hundred years ago, they brought about a revolutionary change for mankind, linking cities and countryside, driving the industrial revolution and irrevocably changing the landscape: a history of the railroad from its beginnings to the present day.

the-makings-of-a-murderer-fatal-mistake.title: Selfless: The Makings of a Champion
the-makings-of-a-murderer-fatal-mistake.overview: Get to know a little more about the Hunter Lawrence story with this short film titled Selfless: The Makings of a Champion. With insights from father Darren Lawrence, brother Jett, and of course Hunter Lawrence himself, it’s a unique look into the mindset and moral compass of an athlete who has both enjoyed and endured one of the most impressive journeys to the top of our sport.
the-makings-of-a-murderer-fatal-mistake.cast: Hunter Lawrence, Jett Lawrence, Darren Lawrence

the-lost-boys-at-the-ritz.title: The Lost Boys
the-lost-boys-at-the-ritz.overview: When an unsuspecting town newcomer is drawn to local blood fiends, the Frog brothers and other unlikely heroes gear up to rescue him.
the-lost-boys-at-the-ritz.cast: Jason Patric, Corey Haim, Dianne Wiest, Barnard Hughes, Edward Herrmann, Kiefer Sutherland

an-american-werewolf-in-london-at-the-ri.title: An American Werewolf in London
an-american-werewolf-in-london-at-the-ri.overview: American tourists David and Jack are savagely attacked by an unidentified animal while hiking on the Yorkshire Moors. After retiring to the home of a beautiful nurse to recuperate, David soon begins experiencing disturbing changes to his body and mind.
an-american-werewolf-in-london-at-the-ri.cast: David Naughton, Griffin Dunne, Jenny Agutter, John Woodvine, Don McKillop, Brian Glover

bugboy.title: Bugboy
bugboy.overview: George, a shy teenager with misaligned eyes, struggles to connect with others after his parents’ divorce. Finding refuge in the world of insects, he bonds with a cricket named Isabella.
bugboy.cast: Yorgos Avgerinos, Paraskevi Makri, Kostas Avgerinos, Ilektra Datsiou

phantoms-of-the-popera-starring-g4.title: Phantoms of the PopEra
phantoms-of-the-popera-starring-g4.overview: Revisit the first music videos of Beat Crusaders' major-era from 2004-2005.
phantoms-of-the-popera-starring-g4.cast: Cim, Toru Hidaka, Takayuki Araki, Taro Kato, Masahiko Kubota, Keita Tanabe

pfs-presents-3-women.title: Peeping Freedom Shutters for Osakabe Sayaka (Apollomat vertical screen PFS_D)
pfs-presents-3-women.overview: Sight and sex viewed through a window.

pfs-presents-miroirs-no-3.title: Peeping Freedom Shutters for Osakabe Sayaka (Apollomat vertical screen PFS_D)
pfs-presents-miroirs-no-3.overview: Sight and sex viewed through a window.

the-godfather-at-the-ritz.title: The Godfather
the-godfather-at-the-ritz.overview: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family. When organized crime family patriarch, Vito Corleone barely survives an attempt on his life, his youngest son, Michael steps in to take care of the would-be killers, launching a campaign of bloody revenge.
the-godfather-at-the-ritz.cast: Marlon Brando, Al Pacino, James Caan, Robert Duvall, Richard S. Castellano, Diane Keaton

the-man-who-fell-to-earth-at-the-ritz.title: The Man Who Fell to Earth
the-man-who-fell-to-earth-at-the-ritz.overview: Thomas Jerome Newton is an alien who has come to Earth in search of water to save his home planet. Aided by lawyer Oliver Farnsworth, Thomas uses his knowledge of advanced technology to create profitable inventions. While developing a method to transport water, Thomas meets Mary-Lou, a quiet hotel clerk, and begins to fall in love with her. Just as he is ready to leave Earth, Thomas is intercepted by the U.S. government, and his entire plan is threatened.
the-man-who-fell-to-earth-at-the-ritz.cast: David Bowie, Rip Torn, Candy Clark, Tony Mascia, Buck Henry, Bernie Casey

pfs-presents-the-sacrifice.title: Peeping Freedom Shutters for Osakabe Sayaka (Apollomat vertical screen PFS_D)
pfs-presents-the-sacrifice.overview: Sight and sex viewed through a window.

guilty-pleasures-at-the-ritz.title: Guilty Pleasures
guilty-pleasures-at-the-ritz.overview: A Christmastime date takes a dark turn when Emily and Arjun, a young couple in the early days of their relationship, begin discussing their guilty pleasures.

die-hard-at-the-ritz.title: Bad Habits Die Hard
die-hard-at-the-ritz.overview: Diana Liviatani is joined in her family house by her almost new boyfriend, Orlando who is going to meet her scary parents. Due to his insecure, clumsy and embarrassing personality, Orlando insists that his best friend Biagio goes along with him. The social gap between the two friends and the Liviatani family is obvious from the start. The Liviatani have been part of the high business class for generations. The misadventures and the personal problems distract the two unfortunate friends from the creepy secret that hides behind the mansion’s walls...
die-hard-at-the-ritz.cast: Gabriel Lo Giudice, Federica Sabatini, Fortunato Cerlino, Antónia Lišková, Giovanni Anzaldo, Giulia Cragnotti

polar-express-at-the-ritz.title: The Polar Express
polar-express-at-the-ritz.overview: When a doubting young boy takes an extraordinary train ride to the North Pole, he embarks on a journey of self-discovery that shows him that the wonder of life never fades for those who believe.
polar-express-at-the-ritz.cast: Tom Hanks, Leslie Zemeckis, Eddie Deezen, Nona Gaye, Peter Scolari, Michael Jeter

new-year-s-eve-dinner-and-party.title: New Year's Eve
new-year-s-eve-dinner-and-party.overview: The lives of several couples and singles in New York intertwine over the course of New Year's Eve.
new-year-s-eve-dinner-and-party.cast: Hilary Swank, Michelle Pfeiffer, Zac Efron, Robert De Niro, Halle Berry, Jessica Biel

princess-live.title: Princess Principal THE LIVE Yuki Kajiura×Void_Chords
princess-live.overview: A live concert performed by Yuki Kajiura and Ryo Takahashi's alias, Void_Chords, presenting to the music of the anime Princess Principal
princess-live.cast: Yuki Kajiura, Ryo Takahashi, Kaori Oda, Keiko, Yuriko Kaida, Joelle Strother

back-to-the-80s-with-riviera-dogs-2027.title: Back to the 80s
back-to-the-80s-with-riviera-dogs-2027.overview: Comedy hip-hop duo Ben & Jensen (actor/director Ben Giroux and songwriter/artist Jensen Reed) present "Back to the 80s" -- an epic parody celebration of the entire 80s decade! Featuring their alter ego faux hair band: WET LEATHER.  This project is the massive sequel to the 2017 "Back to the 90s" music video, which amassed 95 million views on Facebook and charted at #11 on Billboard. "Back to the 80s" took over two years to create, featuring 50 custom sets and multiple iconic vehicles from the 80s -- filmed over the course of six months. Hold on to your mullets...
back-to-the-80s-with-riviera-dogs-2027.cast: Riele Downs, Garrett Clayton, Lauren Storm, Ben Giroux, Chelsea Gilligan, Cameron Kelly

it-s-a-wonderful-life-at-the-ritz.title: It's a Wonderful Life
it-s-a-wonderful-life-at-the-ritz.overview: George Bailey has spent his entire life giving to the people of Bedford Falls.  All that prevents rich skinflint Mr. Potter from taking over the entire town is George's modest building and loan company.  But on Christmas Eve the business's $8,000 is lost and George's troubles begin.
it-s-a-wonderful-life-at-the-ritz.cast: James Stewart, Donna Reed, Lionel Barrymore, Thomas Mitchell, Henry Travers, Beulah Bondi

the-history-of-soul-at-the-ritz.title: The History of Sound
the-history-of-soul-at-the-ritz.overview: In 1917, two young music students attending the Boston Conservatory bond over a mutual love of folk music. They reconnect a few years later, embarking on a song-collecting trip in the backwaters of Maine.
the-history-of-soul-at-the-ritz.cast: Paul Mescal, Josh O'Connor, Chris Cooper, Molly Price, Raphael Sbarge, Hadley Robinson

white-christmas-at-the-ritz.title: White Christmas
white-christmas-at-the-ritz.overview: Two talented song-and-dance men team up after the war to become one of the hottest acts in show business. In time they befriend and become romantically involved with the beautiful Haynes sisters who comprise a sister act.
white-christmas-at-the-ritz.cast: Bing Crosby, Danny Kaye, Rosemary Clooney, Vera-Ellen, Dean Jagger, Mary Wickes

ritz-christmas-party-with-the-soul-rever.title: The Ritz
ritz-christmas-party-with-the-soul-rever.overview: To escape from a mobster, businessman Gaetano Proclo orders a cab driver to take him to a place where he can't be found. Unfortunately for Gaetano, the place turns out to be a gay bathhouse.
ritz-christmas-party-with-the-soul-rever.cast: Jack Weston, Rita Moreno, Jerry Stiller, Kaye Ballard, F. Murray Abraham, Paul B. Price

an-evening-of-burlesque-cabaret-at-the-r.title: An Evening of Fourplay
an-evening-of-burlesque-cabaret-at-the-r.overview: This is the debut of Fourplay, a popular quartet comprised of keyboardist Bob James, guitarist Lee Ritenour, bassist Nathan East, and drummer Harvey Mason. The music sounds more or less like a Bob James small-group date with Ritenour as a major soloist. The style is between jazz, R&B, and pop with an emphasis on lightweight originals, soulful and moderately funky rhythms, and predictable radio-friendly music. Nothing unexpected occurs, but fans of James and Ritenour should enjoy both this CD and Fourplay in general.
an-evening-of-burlesque-cabaret-at-the-r.cast: Bob James, Lee Ritenour, Harvey Mason, Nathan East, Chaka Khan, Philip Bailey

country-superstars.title: Country
country-superstars.overview: Jewell and Gil are farmers. They seem to be working against the odds, producing no financial surplus. Gil has lost hope of ever becoming prosperous, but Jewell decides to fight for her family.
country-superstars.cast: Jessica Lange, Sam Shepard, Wilford Brimley, Matt Clark, Theresa Graham, Levi L. Knebel

jive-aces-at-the-ritz.title: Java Jive
jive-aces-at-the-ritz.overview: A thirsty young man tries to resist a hot drink.
jive-aces-at-the-ritz.cast: Nate Morley, Ryann Bailey, Steven Bartholomew, Todd Morgenegg, Jyllian Petrie, Lee Liston

mark-smith-antiques-expert-on-the-road.title: Mark Smith: Old Smudge
mark-smith-antiques-expert-on-the-road.overview: Mark Smith (Russell Howard's Good News) returns to Edinburgh with a new show and Lord have mercy is he excited. Expect to hear him cram as many funny, stupid and potentially dangerous observations into the show as possible on topics as diverse as bowling, going bowling, and do you like bowling? There's also a couple of dick jokes. In a nutshell then, something for everyone.

seann-walsh-this-is-torture.title: Seann Walsh: Kiss
seann-walsh-this-is-torture.overview: In this hilarious and critically acclaimed stand-up show, Seann Walsh recounts living through the centre of a media storm in his distinctively shambolic, intense and energetic trademark style.  Recorded live at the Bill Murray pub in Angel, London.

once-in-a-lifetime-visionaries-of-the-80.title: Once in a Lifetime
once-in-a-lifetime-visionaries-of-the-80.overview: After losing her husband and baby daughter to a fire, Daphne Fields raises her deaf son while beginning a writing career. Hollywood loves her scripts, but her heart remains with her son Andrew, under the care of Headmaster Matthew Dane at an eastern boarding school. Daphne finally seems to have rediscovered love in her leading man. But an accident leaves her hospitalized, contemplating her life, fate and her best chance for love.
once-in-a-lifetime-visionaries-of-the-80.cast: Lindsay Wagner, Barry Bostwick, Duncan Regehr, Amy Aquino, Rex Smith, Darrell Thomas Utley

falmouth-soul-sensation-at-the-ritz.title: Off The Radar, On The Stage: Music in Falmouth
falmouth-soul-sensation-at-the-ritz.overview: An exploration of Falmouth’s vibrant DIY music scene, capturing the community spirit, resilience, and creativity that keep grassroots music alive in a small university town far away from big cities.

the-magic-of-the-bee-gees-at-the-ritz.title: The Academy of Magic
the-magic-of-the-bee-gees-at-the-ritz.overview: Aura is gifted with magical abilities; she and her friends have many exciting adventures at the academy, but soon Aura learns that the school hatches many dark secrets that she must uncover. Will she be able to unveil the truth?
the-magic-of-the-bee-gees-at-the-ritz.cast: Laura Megan Stahl, Michael Johnston, Ben Diskin, Michael Orenstein, Grant George, Jamieson Price
